about: The PUBLIC fields of report.json. Removing or renaming one, or narrowing its type or values, breaks users and is a deliberate API change; ADDING a field is not, so a report may carry more than this. Fields not listed here are internal and may change in any release.
applies_to: A COMPLETED run: exit 0 (compliant), 1 (not compliant) or 6 (no determination). A run that fails (exit 3, 4 or 5) flushes whatever partial report exists, which may be empty and is not bound by this contract.

compliant.means: true or false is a determination; null means none was made (see compliance_determination and no_determination)

compliance_determination.means: code: an unqualified determination; conditional: it holds only if the authority approves the listed items; no_determination: none could be made

simulated_sections.applies: proposed and reference, when the run simulated them on the reference-building path (a non-empty proposed, and no `path` field)
